merchant/32876.htm.text: Recipe Merchant Desian: Hush! Be quiet... I can't hear over your breathing. Do you hear that? Just listen... can you hear the whispering of the flames? Others don't know how to listen like this... Wha? I was lost in thought. What do you seek?
